in_marathi.name: Ballu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ballu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘वल्लभ’ (Valabha), which means 'bold' or 'brave'. This name is associated with the deity Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted as a warrior protecting the universe from evil.
